new_evidence.summary: EvoTS-Agent uses stagnation-triggered Alternative Strategy plus final Recombination. The paper states test annotations/metrics remain hidden during optimization and uses chronological 60/20/20 splits. On Bee-Dance/GPT-5.4, full F1 is 0.635±0.04 versus 0.578±0.06 without Alternative and 0.575±0.12 without Recombination. This is useful same-system outer-evaluation evidence for strategy reopening, but not a matched Stop/Continue/Widen/Reopen comparison or a statistical promotion certificate.
